name: 50021 · Ankeny, IA
findings: ZIP 50021 (Ankeny) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50021 (Ankeny) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50021 (Ankeny) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
